topic_thesis: Choosing a hospital room above your health insurance policy's 1% room-rent limit triggers proportionate deduction, wiping out up to 50% of your total claim settlement.
strategic_angle: Expose how insurance companies hide the 'Proportionate Deduction Clause' in room rent caps, forcing policyholders to pay ICU, surgeon, and diagnostic fees out-of-pocket even if the total bill is below the sum insured.
target_emotion: Panic and urgency to immediately verify policy room-rent capping clauses
pinned_comment_text: Did your health insurance pay less than expected on your last claim? Drop your experience below, or comment 'POLICY' for our room-rent check guide! 🏥👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Focus on middle-class families in Tamil Nadu. Use relatable Tanglish phrases like 'Insurance Claim Gaali' and 'Hospital Bill Trap', breaking down how an extra ₹1,000 room upgrade leads to a ₹2.5 Lakh loss.
source_signal: Middle-class consumer health insurance claim dispute trends
